payload.note: StartOfRefresh objectives are checked at the start of Refresh — before retrieve, draw missions, advance-time, recruit/build, and deploy. pendingNotices.details: The Rebel player moved 2 units from Dantooine into the hidden Rebel Base. The base itself did NOT move — Rapid Mobilization's other option (establish a new base) was not used, so no probe card changes hands and Dantooine remains a possible base location.
